body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a supreme royal knight-king. BOTH ARMS MUST BE RAISED AND LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES AT SHOULDER HEIGHT LIKE A SCARECROW, elbows perfectly straight, each arm a continuous straight horizontal line from shoulder to fingertip. BOTH HANDS MUST BE COMPLETELY EMPTY AND OPEN with fingers spread, absolutely nothing gripped or held in either hand, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso and between each hand and any other object. UNMISTAKABLY CROWNED: a tall blocky gold crown block with at least 5 sharp spike-blocks worn directly on top of the head. A black domino half-mask block. Large black blocky wing-shapes mounted flat against the back (not near the hands). A gold scepter block strapped diagonally across the BACK ONLY, nowhere near the hands or arms. A short black-and-gold cape block ending above the knee. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, flat blocks with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, fully visible in frame. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin, no text, no logos, no watermark
